name: Wolf3D for iOS (unofficial)
subtitle: Wolfenstein 3D and Spear of Destiny on iPhone and iPad
description:
An unofficial fan port of ECWolf to iPhone and iPad, with touch controls: Wolfenstein 3D, Spear of Destiny and its mission packs, from your own copy of the game.

It's a beta. Setup guide and bug reports: https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/ECWolf/tree/ios

apps.name: Wolf3D
apps.subtitle: Wolfenstein 3D and Spear of Destiny, with touch controls
apps.localizedDescription:
An unofficial fan port of ECWolf, the Wolfenstein 3D source port, to iPhone and iPad: play Wolfenstein 3D, Spear of Destiny and its two mission packs with touch controls made for them.

- Widescreen at a steady 60 frames a second
- A move stick wherever your thumb lands, drag to turn
- A weapon wheel, and quick save / quick load with a short hold
- Six HUD looks, from modern pills to the original status bar
- A camera: photos, bursts, selfies with BJ and the enemies around you, and Action Freeze
- The sithewok cheat (god mode, every weapon and key, noclip) and a list to jump to any level
- Both games in one app

You need your own copy of the game (GOG or Steam); no game files are included. Open the app once, then copy the game's files into Files > On My iPhone > Wolf3D.

It's a beta: expect bugs, and back up your saves. No multiplayer.

Setup guide: https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/ECWolf/blob/ios/docs/ios/README.md

Not affiliated with or endorsed by id Software, ZeniMax, Bethesda or Microsoft, or by the ECWolf developers.
